verdict.rationale: Dataform, documented as the BigQuery workflow service, lets users develop, test, version-control and schedule transformation workflows, with team collaboration through Git. A BigQuery release note adds that pipelines can be created, stored and managed in Git folders. That covers versioning clearly, while review and rollback are only implied by the Git backing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a review/approval flow (e.g., pull requests) and of rolling back a deployed workflow, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
